Traditional Sauna Ritual

SAUNA RITUAL is a sauna visit accompanied by a professional sauna master individually, for two people, or for a larger group. We offer relaxing recreation to experience new sensations and experiences.

"One should bathe in the sauna with a fresh birch whisk, then the body remains white."

  • Ritual Conducted Under Certified Sauna Masters' Guidance
  • Relaxing Herbal Hot Tubs With Nature's Healing Power
  • Refreshing Pond Year-Round

Full Sauna Ritual Experience

Go through the complete 7-step ritual that combines traditional Latvian sauna methods with our sauna masters' unique touch.

Warming in Herbal Hot Tub

We begin the ritual with a gently warm herbal hot tub that prepares the body and soul for a deeper sauna experience. Aromatic herbs help relax and release daily stress.

Herbal Tea Enjoyment

We enjoy warm, medicinal tea that enriches the body with natural vitamins and minerals, while preparing the body for the upcoming ritual steps.

Whisk Beating

The heart of the sauna ritual is the sauna whisk beating, which promotes deep relaxation and body cleansing. The sauna master uses specially prepared birch, oak, or other tree whisks to gently stroke and stimulate the skin, improving circulation and promoting toxin elimination.

Herbal Scrub Application

Herbal scrub is applied to the skin to gently remove dead cells and promote skin renewal. It is made from medicinal plants and salt, providing an exfoliating effect.

Warm Honey Massage

Warm honey is applied to the body and gently massaged to deeply moisturize the skin. Honey's rich properties help make the skin soft, clear, and healthily glowing. Additionally, the procedure calms the mind.

Immersion in Cool Pond

After whisk beating in the sauna, the client is led into a cool pond where the bathing process takes place. Cold water cools the skin and stimulates circulation.

Wrapping in Blankets

After the contrast bath, you are gently wrapped in warm blankets and laid in fresh air. This rest period helps stabilize circulation and concludes the ritual with complete peace.
